facts.rationale: Adds the previously omitted contact guard, fixed helper return, and post-response operation, preserving the distinction between callback invocation, motion-state mutation, and the returned boolean.
facts.value: Runs in spawn-selected motion state 2, whose table animation ID is -1. Every invocation forwards the item and it_802D3090 to it_8027A118, which calls it_8026E4D0 and always returns false. The shared terrain routine refreshes collision data and item position, records a detected floor index, handles the non-floor contact mask, and invokes the response only on its floor-contact path. The response calls it_80273454 and enters motion state 0 with ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE. After the response returns, the shared routine restores normal scale using the model pointer captured before the response. Thus this collision callback can trigger a state change while still returning false; a state change is not requested on every collision tick.
